_README: Author "def": what the thing IS, in one learner-facing clause — not a list
of other translations, which the `en` gloss already gives. Match the sense
in `en`; never drift to another homograph.
"expect" is what the corpus holds now; fix-authored.ts refuses a stale row.

expect.def: down, down here, downstairs (towards the speaker); down, down there, downstairs (away from the speaker)
not hungry, satiated, full, done; full, ample
to come up (of a subject or name in conversation, a difficulty in a project, etc.); to turn up, to appear (in media, at some location, in some period of time, among a group of similar things, etc.)

rows.en: to moan, to groan, to grunt

expect.def: to moan, to groan, to grunt (to vocalize in a low, unarticulated manner, typically as an extension of exhaling); to moan, to groan (to say in a manner involving moaning or reminiscent thereof)
to burn; to light on fire; to burn; to be on fire

rows.en: a sort, variety, grade of a good produced for sale or consumption

expect.def: a sort, variety, grade of a good produced for sale or consumption; a sort, kind, type of anything
space; place, area, field, room, space
appearance, look, comportment, behavior; gig, appearance, performance

rows.en: decent, decorous, reputable, civilized, honest, moral, of integrity

expect.def: decent, decorous, reputable, civilized, honest, moral, of integrity; decent, proper, as it should be

rows.en: to take, take up, assume, span

expect.def: to take, take up, assume, span (a position, space, area); to take, to have (food, drink, medicine)

rows.en: to save, save up, put aside

expect.def: to save, save up, put aside (money) (the reflexive pronoun may be left out in order to distinguish more clearly from sense 2); to spare, to save

rows.en: to bind, to tie, to fasten something by means of a string etc.

expect.def: to bind, to tie, to fasten something by means of a string etc.; to tie, to fasten a string etc.
to communicate, to exchange information; to communicate, to receive Communion
post; pillar (long, fairly thick piece of wood or metal used to stabilise something); post; pole; pale (such an object used for purposes other than stabilisation)
to weigh; to be of a certain weight; to weigh; to measure the weight of
supplement, addition, complement, supplementation; object, complement
